message: The other day, I realized we hadn't updated our go-bags in a while. Instead of it feeling like a chore, I turned it into a cozy little family event. We spread everything out on the kitchen table, and as we sorted through supplies, we shared stories about our favorite camping trips. It became a sweet reminder that being prepared doesn’t have to be stressful; it can be a chance to bond and laugh together. Do you have any fun ways to make preparedness feel less daunting?
